summary.one_liner: A Markdown template and printable dialogue sheet for writing a Run Book (operations manual) for a software system, to drive discussion between developers and operations staff.
keywords: document how to operate my software
summary.what_it_does: The repository provides run-book-template.md, a Markdown template of suggested operational checks and procedures for most non-trivial software systems, meant to be copied and turned into a Run Book or System Operation Manual. Each section includes a description explaining its context and why it is needed. The README also includes a Run Book Dialogue Sheet, a PDF (about 300KB) with headings taken from the template, designed to be printed at A1 size for team workshops. The README recommends that the development team own the Run Book, with testers and operations staff filling gaps. It advises marking missing information clearly (for example with WARNING) and marking sections that do not apply as N/A after checking. It also suggests automating checks once teams agree on them.
use_cases: writing a run book for a software system
running a team workshop between developers and ops
how_to_run: Edit run-book-template.md and add your own operational and runtime checks
Remove or mark as N/A the sections that do not apply (double-check first)
Use the template to drive discussion between developers and ops
Optionally print the Run Book Dialogue Sheet PDF at A1 size for a team session
Automate the validated checks and procedures
notable: Designed as a discussion tool first; the README stresses that discussion, not documentation, is where the value lies
Includes a printable A1 Run Book Dialogue Sheet based on Allan Kelly's Dialogue Sheets, used with permission
Asks teams to flag missing knowledge explicitly (e.g. WARNING) rather than leave gaps
Companion book reference: Team Guide to Software Operability, with a chapter on Run Book collaboration
caveats: The README says it is a starting point and sections often need to be reviewed, adapted, or marked N/A
Expects the software may need redesign to meet the operational needs outlined in the template
The template is from 2014-2016 copyright; the README does not state recent maintenance status
The README does not give an installation process; it is a set of documents to copy and edit
